title: Koko Eating Bananas
kidExplanation: Koko must finish banana piles before guards return. Find the slowest eating speed that still works.
plainProblem: Koko Eating Bananas: Koko must finish banana piles before guards return. Worked example — input: piles = [3,6,7,11], h = 8; expected output: 4. Why: Min speed. Interview pattern to name out loud: Binary search (halving the range).

thinkingSteps.body: Count the nested work. If each choice restarts a full scan, time blows up. Name the cost before optimizing — interviewers want that honesty. Target after the insight: O(n * log(max_pile).

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: The key idea is to perform binary search to find the minimum value of the integer 'k' such that Koko can eat all the bananas within 'hours' hours. We can define a binary search space for 'k' and perform binary search to find the smallest 'k' that satisfies the given condition.
